evals.prompt: make a logo for my friend's barber shop in Tirana, it's called Kapo. he wants something minimal, black and white, no website yet. he needs it for the shop sign and instagram
evals.expected_output: A complete minimal logo set for 'Kapo' in black and white: outlined SVG wordmark and variants, icon, Instagram avatar, PNGs and favicon, proof.png, README with rules; one recommendation with reasoning; no invented facts.

evals.prompt: We just opened a small gelato kiosk next to Bar Martiri in Spille and need a logo for it. Call it 'Martiri Gelato'. It should clearly belong to the same family as barmartiri.com, so follow the website's colours, and keep it minimal.
evals.expected_output: Reads barmartiri.com's colours and fonts with site_palette.py, reuses ink/paper and one ice-cream accent, produces the full logo set with icon and favicons, a proof and a README; recommendation explains the family link to Bar Martiri.

evals.prompt: I'm launching a calm little note-taking app called Tidepool (working name). Need a logo plus favicon and an app icon that looks good on an iPhone home screen. Modern but not cold.
evals.expected_output: A modern, warm wordmark and a strong app icon (square, full-bleed), favicon set, proof showing the icon at small sizes, README; no invented claims about the app.
